schema: SLeeLa FRUCHST definition review queue v2

frequency_source.code_license: MIT (not the license for extracted data)
attribution: Wiktionary contributors via Kaikki/Wiktextract (CC BY-SA 4.0; upstream dataset attribution)
frequency_source.selection: First 1,000 unique NFC-normalized lemmas encountered in source frequency_rank order from the upstream top-2,000 preview. Duplicate lemmas across POS rows are collapsed to their highest-frequency row; original source_rank and frequency_count are retained.
caveats: Frequency-candidate staging only; not a completed FRUCHST dictionary.
OpenSubtitles-derived rankings are subtitle-domain rankings, not a balanced general-purpose corpus.
Counts are corpus occurrences, not normalized per million; do not compare raw counts across languages.
Three definitions (English, French, Spanish) are not yet supplied; no binary should be generated from this staging data.

en.license: Wiktionary dual license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; preserve attribution and verify edition notices

fr.license: Wiktionary dual license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; preserve attribution and verify edition notices

es.license: Wiktionary dual license: CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; preserve attribution and verify edition notices

alignment_policy: Exact NFC headword, exact target language, normalized candidate POS, and shared sense-level Wikidata QID across all three editions. Every matched sense remains a review candidate; no sense is auto-selected or approved. Multiple source senses are retained separately.
